🔥 WifiWatch | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with real-time monitoring and historical logging of their Wi-Fi network performance, identifying and diagnosing connection issues.
✨ Key Features: • Live status of Wi-Fi, router, and internet • Logs and categorizes network problems (Wi-Fi, home network, provider, DNS) • Intelligent notifications for serious or persistent issues • DFS channel change warnings due to radar
📖 Summary: Wifi Watch is a Windows 11 tray application written in C# that monitors your Wi-Fi connection's channel, signal strength, and ping latency. It logs network issues, identifies their source (Wi-Fi, home network, provider, or DNS), and notifies users of significant or prolonged problems, including warnings about DFS channel changes due to radar.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 UltraExplorer | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an intuitive and visually engaging way to navigate, manage, and understand complex file system hierarchies on Windows.
✨ Key Features: • Zoomable filesystem canvas • Native Windows file manager • Direct3D 11 rendering • Colour Tags for organization • Split view functionality
📖 Summary: UltraExplorer is a native Windows file manager that visualizes the file system as a zoomable canvas. It allows users to navigate and understand folder hierarchies intuitively by 'flying' into directories while maintaining awareness of the overall structure. The tool integrates familiar file management features with a novel zoomable user interface and quick preview capabilities.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 inspektor-gadget | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: System inspection and data collection on Kubernetes and Linux hosts using eBPF.
✨ Key Features: • Build and package eBPF programs into OCI images (Gadgets) • Targets Kubernetes clusters and Linux hosts • Collect and export data to observability tools • Security mechanisms for Gadget execution control • Automatic enrichment of kernel data to high-level resources
📖 Summary: Inspektor Gadget is a framework and toolset for collecting data and inspecting systems on Kubernetes clusters and Linux hosts. It leverages eBPF technology to package, deploy, and run eBPF programs (called Gadgets) encapsulated in OCI images, offering mechanisms for customization and extension.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 ubuntu-cleaner | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: System cleaning and disk space optimization for Ubuntu operating systems.
✨ Key Features: • Clear browser cache • Clear APT cache • Clear thumbnail cache • Remove unneeded packages • Remove old kernels
📖 Summary: Ubuntu Cleaner is a Python-based tool designed to free up disk space and remove private information on Ubuntu systems. It offers a user-friendly way to clear various caches, uninstall unneeded packages, and remove old system components.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 straps | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating and simplifying the testing of cloud-native applications, Docker containers, Kubernetes deployments, and general system administration tasks using Bash scripts and the Bats testing framework.
✨ Key Features: • Data Type Validation (integers, floats, strings, unsigned integers) • String Operations (starts with, ends with, contains)
📖 Summary: Straps is a comprehensive Bash testing harness that provides over 80 utility functions designed to streamline testing for cloud-native development, Docker containers, Kubernetes, system administration, and DevOps automation. It integrates seamlessly with the Bats testing framework, offering robust validation for data types, network operations, file systems, and cloud infrastructure components.
